evidence_class: Two real ledger server processes sharing one SQLite ledger folder, the ledger_writer command as a third process, no Redis fixture. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.ledger_writer.WriterLease(directory).acquire(claimant): non-blocking exclusive flock on <ledger dir>/.ledger-writer.lock held for the process lifetime, holder recorded as {pid, host, started_at}
WriterConflict names the folder and holder: 'ledger folder <dir> already has an active writer, pid <pid> on <host>; a second writer is refused'
conflicts_total(directory) reads ledger_writer_conflicts_total from .ledger-writer-conflicts.jsonl, one line per refusal
ledger_server.serve acquires the lease before legacy adoption, threads or port binding and exits non-zero on WriterConflict
snapshot(database, target): SQLite backup API copy into a hidden temporary beside the target, integrity checked, renamed into place
restore(backup, directory): verifies the backup, takes the writer lease, writes the backup over ledgers.sqlite3 through the backup API
Chart agentihooks-swarm: ledger.replicas other than 1 fails helm template; kind-smoke.sh checks the refusal

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 as run by the mutation preflight
supported_versions.storage: SQLite ledger repository (ledgers.sqlite3, WAL) on a local or ReadWriteOnce volume
supported_versions.compatibility: The local workstation server keeps its folder and port; a second server on the same folder now exits instead of sharing it

states.observed: Second server exit code, its log line naming the holder, health probe on its port, ledger revision and chat read read-only from SQLite
states.accepted: First server answers 200 with the operation applied; a replay of the same operation id after restart is answered applied without a second entry
states.committed: Chat entries and revision in the authoritative SQLite ledger after kill and restart; restored backup equals the committed state
states.externally_verified: Not claimed; live G3 evidence is required at the rollout gate

validation.red: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38050366503 failed collecting the new test module (ImportError: ledger_writer) on the tests-only commit 99a85be7
validation.mutation_preflight: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38052346742 on 12ca9210: ledger_writer 242 killed 0 survived, ledger_server 5 killed, all three package cases passed twice in the clean run; the run is red only on 13 survivors in scripts/swarm_v2/api/tasks.py lines owned by SV2-LDG-03
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed; helm template refused ledger.replicas=2 locally

rollback_rehearsal.action: Stop the writer, restore a verified snapshot with the ledger_writer restore command under the writer lease, start the preceding writer
rollback_rehearsal.evidence: T-SV2-LDG-04-C restores the snapshot taken after the accepted write over a newer state and reads back the committed state; T-SV2-LDG-04-B shows restore refused while a writer serves
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: ledgers.sqlite3 with its page tokens; the writer lease file is coordination state the kernel releases. Rollback deletes neither.

failure_evidence: Run 38050459957 failed one unit test because tmp_path holds a _home folder from test isolation; fixed by giving the snapshot test its own folder.
remaining_limitations: flock does not coordinate writers across NFS or other shared network filesystems; the doc forbids such a folder
Command line tools that open the repository directly stay secondary writers serialized by SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE
The conflict counter is a file in the ledger folder and has no exporter
Live G3 deployment evidence is required at the rollout gate; these are mocked fixtures
